description: Inbox Monster helps email teams review deliverability, inbox placement, reputation, spamtrap, engagement, creative rendering, delivery test, and oversight data from their InboxMonster account. Users can investigate campaign performance, inspect rendering QA results, manage monitored domains and IPs, create rendering and delivery-test workflows, and review or update account configuration through ChatGPT.
